## How to open a topic

Use `https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=<slug>` where `<slug>` is from `data/tags.json`.

Examples:

- https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=oh-barbara
- https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=%D0%BE%D1%85-%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%B0
- https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=twitch-oh-barbara
- https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=oh-barbara_video
- https://oh-barbara.com/index.html?id=phuket-oh-barbara
